title: KEEPER: Learning Control-Sufficient Textual Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_zh: KEEPER：为长时程LLM智能体学习控制充分性的文本记忆

paragraphs.en: Recursive textual memory can carry earlier errors into later updates, yet task performance alone does not establish memory reliability. We define self-consistency bias as the persistence of incorrect claims already present in the incoming memory. We present KEEPER, a comparative analysis of four auxiliary objectives along information-content and update-sensitivity axes within a shared recursive interface, examining how supervision targets relate to agent performance. Among evaluated conditions, reward-related prediction achieves the highest task performance before and after offline reinforcement learning, outperforming joint supervision. A claim-level analysis of one baseline trajectory documents error persistence despite corrective observations. Together, these analyses motivate evaluating error persistence and valid-information retention alongside task outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 递归式文本记忆会将早期错误带入后续更新，但仅凭任务表现并不能证明记忆的可靠性。 我们将自一致性偏差定义为已存在于输入记忆中的错误断言的持续保留。 我们提出 KEEPER，在共享的递归接口下，沿信息量与更新敏感性两个维度对四种辅助目标进行对比分析，考察监督目标与智能体表现之间的关系。 在所评估的条件中，与奖励相关的预测在离线强化学习前后均取得最高的任务表现，优于联合监督。 对一条基线轨迹的断言级分析记录了尽管存在纠正性观察、错误仍持续存在的现象。 这些分析共同表明，应在任务结果之外同时评估错误持续性与有效信息保留情况。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon language agents need information from earlier interactions to guide later decisions. We use textual memory to mean a natural-language summary of past observations, actions, and task progress that an agent uses for subsequent decisions. In recursive memory systems, a generator updates this summary using the previous memory and the latest interaction Zhou et al. (2026) ; Yu et al. (2026a) ; Zhen et al. (2026) . We use self-consistency to describe agreement between successive memories on historical claims that new evidence has not revised. Preserving valid historical claims matters when the current observation leaves earlier events unspecified, including whether a prerequisite action has already been completed.
paragraphs.zh: 长时程语言智能体需要来自早期交互的信息来指导后续决策。 我们用文本记忆指代对过去观察、动作和任务进展的自然语言总结，智能体将其用于后续决策。 在递归记忆系统中，生成器利用先前的记忆和最新交互来更新该总结 Zhou et al. (2026) ；Yu et al. (2026a) ；Zhen et al. (2026) 。 我们用自一致性来描述相继的记忆之间在未被新证据修订的历史论断上的一致程度。 当当前观察未明确早期事件时（包括某个前置动作是否已经完成），保留有效的历史论断就显得尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: Agreement between successive memories does not establish the factual correctness of the information they share. Language models can repeat the same incorrect answer across independent samples from a fixed input, and existing detection methods struggle to identify such errors Tan et al. (2025) . Recursive memory adds a further route to agreement: each update conditions on the previous memory, so a claim can recur through reuse rather than independent regeneration. If a memory incorrectly records a prerequisite as completed, later updates may repeat that statement while new observations leave the issue unresolved. This concern is related to intrinsic self-correction: in reasoning tasks, revising an answer without external feedback does not reliably improve performance Huang et al. (2024) .
paragraphs.zh: 相邻多次记忆之间的一致性并不能确立它们所共享信息在事实上的正确性。 语言模型在固定输入下跨独立采样时可能重复相同的错误答案，而现有检测方法难以识别此类错误 Tan et al. (2025) 。 递归记忆为进一步达成一致性提供了另一条途径：每次更新都以上一次记忆为条件，因此某一论断可以通过复用而非独立再生成而反复出现。 如果记忆错误地将某个前置条件记录为已完成，后续更新可能会重复该陈述，而新的观察却使问题仍未解决。 这一担忧与内在自我修正相关：在推理任务中，在没有外部反馈的情况下修改答案并不能可靠地提升性能 Huang et al. (2024) 。

paragraphs.en: We refer to the persistence of incorrect claims already present in the incoming memory across successive updates as self-consistency bias . The focus is on the continuation of an existing error; the generation of a new error is a separate event. In agents that retrieve stored experiences, inaccuracies in past experiences propagate to later tasks Xiong et al. (2026) ; there, stored records are reused as retrieved, whereas recursive memory is rewritten at every update. Whether self-consistency bias occurs in recursively rewritten memory, and under which update conditions, requires direct evaluation in the memory system.
paragraphs.zh: 我们把输入记忆中已有的错误断言在 successive 更新中持续存在这一现象称为自一致性偏差。 这里关注的是既有错误的延续；新错误的生成是另一个独立事件。 在检索存储经验的智能体中，过往经验中的不准确之处会传播到后续任务中（Xiong et al. (2026)）；在这类系统中，存储的记录被原样重用，而递归记忆在每次更新时都会被重写。 自一致性偏差是否会在递归重写的记忆中出现、以及在何种更新条件下出现，需要在记忆系统中进行直接评估。

paragraphs.en: If an intervention reduces self-consistency bias, that reduction alone is insufficient to establish an improvement in memory quality. An update that discards historical information can remove errors while also losing correct facts needed for later decisions. Improving recursive memory therefore requires reducing self-consistency bias while preserving historical information that remains correct and relevant to the task.
paragraphs.zh: 如果某种干预减少了自一致性偏差，那么仅凭这一减少不足以证明记忆质量得到了提升。 一次丢弃历史信息的更新在去除错误的同时，也可能丢失后续决策所需的正确事实。 因此，改进递归记忆需要在减少自一致性偏差的同时，保留仍然正确且与任务相关的历史信息。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches Zhou et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2026a) ; Wang et al. (2026) train memory using task feedback, memory-specific credit assignment, and learned summarization decisions. These training signals can encourage the retention of useful information. However, improved task scores alone leave unclear how the properties encouraged by training affect self-consistency bias and the retention of valid historical information. We therefore compare auxiliary objectives that target different properties of recursive memory updates.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法 Zhou et al. (2026)；Li et al. (2026a)；Wang et al. (2026) 使用任务反馈、特定于记忆的信用分配以及学习到的摘要决策来训练记忆。 这些训练信号可以促使有用信息的保留。 然而，仅凭任务分数的提升，无法说明训练所鼓励的属性如何影响自一致性偏差以及有效历史信息的保留。 因此，我们比较了针对递归记忆更新不同属性的辅助目标。

paragraphs.en: We organize the analysis along two axes. The first concerns information content , specifically which information the memory generator’s internal representation retains. Approximate information-state theory motivates reward-related and predictive information as complementary criteria under explicit assumptions Subramanian et al. (2022) ; Ni et al. (2024) . Semantic agreement with reference memories provides a comparison for these task-related signals. The second concerns update sensitivity , specifically how changes in the incoming memory affect the subsequent update. Recursive reuse motivates examining this sensitivity, because errors in one memory become part of the input to the next update.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿着两个维度来组织分析。 第一个维度涉及信息内容，具体而言是记忆生成器的内部表示保留了哪些信息。 近似信息状态理论在明确假设下，将奖励相关信息与预测信息作为互补的判据（Subramanian et al. (2022)；Ni et al. (2024)）。 与参考记忆的语义一致性为这些任务相关信号提供了一个比较基准。 第二个维度涉及更新敏感性，具体而言是输入记忆的变化如何影响后续更新。 递归复用促使我们考察这种敏感性，因为一个记忆中的错误会成为下一次更新输入的一部分。

paragraphs.en: We introduce KEEPER to analyze how auxiliary supervision affects task outcomes within a fixed recursive memory interface. We evaluate four auxiliary objectives, individually and jointly, and compare task outcomes before and after offline reinforcement learning. For each objective, we specify a hypothesis linking its supervision mechanism to recursive memory quality. A complementary claim-level analysis examines how incorrect claims persist across updates in one baseline trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 KEEPER，以分析在固定的递归记忆接口下，辅助监督如何影响任务结果。 我们对四种辅助目标进行单独和联合评估，并比较离线强化学习前后的任务结果。 对于每个目标，我们给出一个假设，将其监督机制与递归记忆质量联系起来。 一项补充性的论断级分析考察了在一个基线轨迹中，错误论断如何跨更新持续存在。

paragraphs.en: We compare three objectives for information content . (1) Reward Preservation (Sec. 3.2.1 ) requires reward-related prediction, which we hypothesize encourages representations to retain distinctions relevant to task progress. (2) Predictive Preservation (Sec. 3.2.2 ) requires successor prediction, motivating the retention of future-relevant information beyond immediate reward. (3) Semantic Anchoring (Sec. 3.2.3 ) aligns a learned projection with the semantic representation of a reference memory. We hypothesize that this alignment encourages the generator to preserve valid historical information in its output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了三种信息内容目标。 (1) 奖励保持（第 3.2.1 节）要求进行与奖励相关的预测，我们假设这会促使表征保留与任务进展相关的区分。 (2) 预测保持（第 3.2.2 节）要求进行后继预测，从而促使保留即时奖励之外与未来相关的信息。 (3) 语义锚定（第 3.2.3 节）将学习到的投影与参考记忆的语义表示对齐。 我们假设这种对齐会促使生成器在其输出中保留有效的历史信息。

paragraphs.en: (4) Update Stability (Sec. 3.3.1 ) constrains sensitivity to incoming-memory perturbations, motivating a reduction in their influence on subsequent updates.

paragraphs.en: We also evaluate all four objectives jointly. The task results show that the benefits of individual objectives do not necessarily accumulate under joint supervision. Together with the error persistence observed in a baseline trajectory, these findings motivate evaluating recursive memory through both task outcomes and direct assessment of self-consistency bias and valid-information retention.

paragraphs.en: Reward Preservation (RP) supervises information that distinguishes reward-related outcomes. Approximate information-state theory motivates expected-reward prediction as a criterion for retaining decision-relevant information Subramanian et al. (2022) , and latent-state modeling uses reward prediction to constrain state representations Gelada et al. (2019) . The relevant mechanism is the pressure to distinguish examples with different targets: if their representations are indistinguishable, a predictor receiving those representations cannot account for the target difference. When the difference depends on historical task progress, preserving that information helps reduce prediction error. Reward supervision therefore adds an explicit prediction requirement beyond reference-token likelihood.

paragraphs.en: Update Stability constrains the influence of incoming-memory perturbations on the next representation. An erroneous claim in one memory becomes part of the input to the next update, providing a route for its influence to persist. Recurrent stability theory relates sensitivity to the propagation of state differences: under a uniformly contractive update and identical external inputs, differences caused by an initial state decay over successive updates Miller and Hardt (2019) . This principle motivates penalizing sensitivity to perturbed incoming memories Jukić and Šnajder (2025) . paragraphs.en: We examine how auxiliary supervision of recursive memory affects whole-agent task scores on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld. We compare each objective individually and all four jointly, before and after offline reinforcement learning (RL). A qualitative analysis of a recorded memory trajectory then examines how incorrect claims persist, recur, and disappear across updates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究递归记忆的辅助监督如何影响智能体在 ScienceWorld 和 ALFWorld 上的整体任务得分。 我们逐个比较每种目标函数以及四者联合使用的效果，并比较离线强化学习（RL）前后的表现。 随后，我们对一条记录的记忆轨迹进行定性分析，考察错误论断如何在多次更新中持续存在、反复出现并最终消失。

paragraphs.en: Our KEEPER has provided a comparative analysis of how four auxiliary supervision objectives affect task outcomes within a shared recursive memory interface, distinguishing information content from update sensitivity. On ScienceWorld and ALFWorld, Reward Preservation and Update Stability have improved over behavioral cloning after supervised initialization, whereas Predictive Preservation and Semantic Anchoring have yielded lower task scores and success rates. Reward Preservation has ranked highest both before and after offline reinforcement learning, exceeding joint supervision. The effects of subsequent offline reinforcement learning have varied across benchmarks and initialization conditions. A complementary baseline analysis has documented error persistence despite corrective observations. Together, these findings have shown that the task-level benefits of auxiliary memory supervision vary with the supervision target and training condition, and that the benefits of individual objectives do not necessarily accumulate under joint supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 KEEPER 提供了一项对比分析，考察四个辅助监督目标在共享递归记忆接口下对任务结果的影响，并区分了信息内容与更新敏感性。 在 ScienceWorld 和 ALFWorld 上，奖励保持与更新稳定性在监督初始化之后优于行为克隆，而预测性保持与语义锚定则产生了较低的任务得分和成功率。 奖励保持在离线强化学习前后均排名第一，超过了联合监督。 后续离线强化学习的效果因基准和初始化条件而异。 一项补充性的基线分析记录了尽管存在纠正性观察错误仍持续存在的现象。 总而言之，这些发现表明，辅助记忆监督在任务层面的收益随监督目标和训练条件而变化，且单个目标的收益在联合监督下未必能够叠加。

paragraphs.en: The released configuration uses three RL epochs, an actor learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , a critic learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and a critic warm-up of 100 training iterations. The discount factor is 0.99 0.99 , the target-network update coefficient is 0.2 0.2 , and the expectile parameter is 0.95 0.95 . The RL configuration points to the same DeepSpeed batch configuration as BC. The dataset loader appends the configured collected files to the expert data for each policy role. paragraphs.en: The denominator uses the Euclidean distance between the frozen, normalized embeddings of the clean and perturbed previous memories, with stabilizer δ = 10 − 4 \delta=10^{-4} . paragraphs.en: A claim is contradicted when its stated content conflicts with the recorded environment state, and consistent when it agrees with that state. An omitted claim is absent from the memory text. An ambiguous claim lacks enough detail for either correctness judgment. These categories describe the displayed case; they do not constitute an aggregate automatic metric. Persistence denotes an incorrect claim continuing across successive updates. Recurrence denotes an incorrect claim appearing again after a correct statement. Omission alone provides no evidence that the generator has replaced an incorrect claim with the correct one.
